query_accounting_sanity_check.interpretation: Conservative uncached ordinary compression calls for one real activation; a local arithmetic check, not a numerical security-budget instantiation.
query_accounting_sanity_check.note: Each relevant reduction must include all remaining real activations in its complete q budget, in addition to other preparation, primitives, controller and test work.

resolved_findings.issue: One selected leaf token restores a HybridKey, but its other component need not match the separately selected leaf. Recoverability of one reservation did not imply both selected component secrets.
resolved_findings.resolution: The text and finite closure now require collective coverage of selected_pq_owner and selected_x_owner; one leaf alone does not derive S0. A single owner suffices only when both actual selected public components match.

checked_in: known-root block and ACK-tag derivation relations
resolved_findings.issue: Idealizing all activation blocks at an unprotected root while revealing raw K_B breaks the public deterministic root-to-block/ACK relation.
resolved_findings.resolution: Only protected descriptors are idealized, marked at first allocation before root disclosure or activation use. Aliases share mark and handle; unprotected entries retain real activation of current-game root values, and protected root/ACK recipes stop before return.

source_correspondence_checks: A complete acquired aggregate image contributes all readable records, including prekey inventory and other sessions.
Pending-wire target ciphertext is publicly projectable; its private payload requires J. Later J opens previously captured targets.
J derives O and G. Tokens use O, separate signer files use G, and acquiring a journal does not imply acquiring the signer file.
Operation tokens contain a digest binding original public inputs; actual original peer/context inputs remain required for reconstruction.
Consumed/abandoned one-time payloads and retired empty payloads are not generation tokens; independently retained reusable prekey records remain sources.
Marker-3 bootstrap zeroing is separate from the message record and previously acquired versions.
Public projection, fixed-edge guarded decryption, and bootstrap deterministic recipe closures compose because the declared recipe rules introduce no new J/O/G keys.
Resealing, pending-write reconciliation, failed acknowledgment, deletion, and later disclosure preserve original source identity and cumulative acquired versions.
